coordinateConvention: All geometry is original uncropped source-normalizedx/y0..1, origin top-left. SourceTime is native presentation time; root must transform once into the final cut/layout.
timeConvention: Intervals are sourceIn inclusive/sourceOutExclusive. Keyframes include native frame indices and measured sourcePTS. Show a held final sampled frame for one native frame only; no extrapolation beyond visible intervals. Render only the intersection of a burst with its selected source cut; a final evidence keyframe may coincide with an exclusive cut endpoint.
method: Direct inspection of CPU-extracted native PNGs at0.25–0.5second spacing; manually authored geometry. Gold contour vertices were assisted by a boundedHSV pixel mask and convex hull, then visually checked as editorial focus only. No detector labels, confidence, world measurements or fabricated game telemetry.
